shortDescription: Manage pfSense OpenVPN Client Specific Overrides

options.name: block
options.description: Block this client connection based on its common name.

options.name: custom_options
options.description: Additional options to add for this client specific override, separated by a semicolon.

options.name: local_network
options.description: IPv4 networks that will be accessible from the remote endpoint.

options.name: local_networkv6
options.description: IPv6 networks that will be accessible from the remote endpoint.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the override. The X.509 common name for the client certificate, or the username for VPNs utilizing password authentication. This match is case sensitive.

options.name: netbios_ntype
options.description: NetBIOS Node Type. Possible options: b-node (broadcasts), p-node (point-to-point name queries to a WINS server), m-node (broadcast then query name server), and h-node (query name server, then broadcast). Default is 'none'.

options.name: netbios_scope
options.description: A NetBIOS Scope ID provides an extended naming service for NetBIOS over TCP/IP. The NetBIOS scope ID isolates NetBIOS traffic on a single network to only those nodes with the same NetBIOS scope ID.

options.name: push_reset
options.description: Prevent this client from receiving any server-defined client settings.

options.name: remote_network
options.description: IPv4 networks that will be routed through the tunnel.

options.name: remote_networkv6
options.description: IPv6 networks that will be routed through the tunnel.

options.name: server_list
options.description: A list of OpenVPN servers this applies to.

options.name: state
options.description: State in which to leave the override

options.name: tunnel_network
options.description: IPv4 virtual network used for private communications between this server and client hosts expressed using CIDR notation.

options.name: tunnel_networkv6
options.description: IPv6 virtual network used for private communications between this server and client hosts expressed using CIDR notation.

options.name: wins_server_enable
options.description: Provide a WINS server list to clients,
